account: Emirates Health Services runs a platform that combines an assistance chatbot called Ask EHS, accessibility tools, multilingual support and digital healthcare services. In its submission to the International Telecommunication Union, current as of June 2025, the agency describes features that are intended to reduce access barriers and administrative work. The submission names Mahmoud Alaa Omran and Amal Karmostaje of Emirates Health Services as contacts. Its partners include UAE Pass, the Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority and the Ministry of Health and Prevention. The agency notes that the AI infrastructure is costly to set up and that the platform depends on internet access, so it built a lightweight version for slow connections. The submission does not quantify a change in staff workload, patient access or health. Its claims about carbon emissions and universal coverage describe broader intended effects. The agency's accessibility statement shows that the sign language and speech features were still offered in October 2026. The agency has published no usage or outcome figures.
